title: Trump Says US Could Still 'Smack' Iran
title_cn: 特朗普称美国仍可“打击”伊朗
summary: President Donald Trump dismissed concerns that the conflict in Iran was draining American firepower, saying "This is a relatively little war for us." Bloomberg's Mica Soellner reports from the White House. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: India's Modi Calls on Putin to End War in Ukraine
title_cn: 印度莫迪呼吁普京结束乌克兰战争
summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi called on President Vladimir Putin to end Russia’s war in Ukraine during a meeting in Kyrgyzstan. Putin responded that "we're moving in this direction." The meeting took place on the sidelines of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Bessent Faces G20 Credibility Test | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 8/31/2026
title_cn: 贝森特面临G20可信度考验 |彭博商业周刊日报 8/31/2026
summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s interventionist summer has already led to pushback and questions about his credibility in financial markets. Now he faces a test with global peers. Ahead of the meeting of Group of 20 finance ministers in Asheville, North Carolina, on Monday, Bessent has vowed to return the conversation among the world’s top economic policymakers to the core subject of boosting growth. Shawn Donnan, Bloomberg Senior Economics Writer talks about the latest from the G20. Ed Ludlow, Bloomberg Tech Co-Host also discussed his interview with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Then, Brian Quintenz, KalshiEx Board Member and Fmr. CFTC Commissioner joined to discuss recent enforcement actions from the prediction market platform. Finally, Ryan Gould, Bloomberg News Deals Reporter discussed the latest on his reporting about how KKR has spent the past five years leveraging limited airport space to the advantage of Atlantic. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Dismisses ‘Little War’ With Iran as Mideast Clashes Resume
title_cn: 中东冲突重启，特朗普驳斥与伊朗的“小规模战争”
summary: President Donald Trump dismissed concerns that the conflict in Iran was draining American firepower as clashes resumed in the on-again off-again hostilities that have stretched more than six months, with neither side willing to restart negotiations to end the war.
